'''Darth Nephantes''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Before attending a meeting with a number of other [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lords, he had the meeting site inspected and found that the meeting was actually an ambush.
